# Sprint 154 — S154.3 parser-exclusive causal audit (findings only)

Generated by `BASHPP_AUDIT_CORPUS=<go/test> go test ./gosource/testdata/sprint154/parser/` — an AUDIT, not a gate.
Corpus: Go 1.27.0 `go/test`; roots: `roots.txt` (the 83 non-optimizer `errorcheck` roots of Sprint 154).
Front end: `gosource.Load` with default `Options` (the `--check` path). Expectations collected per upstream
`cmd/internal/testdir/testdir_test.go` wantedErrors/errorCheck (rules quoted in `audit.go`).

Stage = component that produced the first wrong diagnostic (scanner < parser < checker). Class = the first failure in that stage.
Notes: `chk-after-syn` = the root has syntax diagnostics AND go/types diagnostics (gc stops at syntax errors); `dup=n` = n diagnostics matched an expectation already satisfied on the same line (upstream tolerates these); `related=n` = n go/types related-info parts (`\tprevious case` …) folded into their main diagnostic as gc prints them — `ErrorList.Error()` prints them as standalone `file:line:col: \t…` lines, which the upstream harness would count as Unmatched Errors.

## Spike S — gc `cmd/compile/internal/syntax` as the syntax verdict (findings only)

gc's Go 1.27.0 syntax package copied to an excluded scratch dir (16 non-test files, 7533 lines; `_test.go` files and `testdata/` dropped), built unmodified. Imports (all std): `fmt`, `go/build/constraint`, `go/constant`, `io`, `os`, `path/filepath`, `reflect`, `regexp`, `strconv`, `strings`, `unicode`, `unicode/utf8`. Driven as `syntax.Parse(NewFileBase(short), src, errh(collect all), nil, syntax.CheckBranches)`; gc's `syntax error: ` prefix kept, and gc's `base.ErrorfAt` per-line filter applied (one `syntax error` per line; equal non-syntax messages on one line collapsed — quoted in `gcParse`). The same `Classify` as Part 1 is run on its diagnostics. gc runs no type checker after a syntax error, so for a syntax-stage root every expectation must be met by the parser alone — a `checker/missing` verdict here means gc's parser accepted the file (an accept/reject divergence, listed below), not a checker gap.

Part 1 scanner/parser-stage roots: 50. gc's parser alone turns **49** of them to pass. Remaining 1: gc-accepts=1
